newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA AUCTION OFFERS FROM JULY 25 - BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA AUCTION OFFERS FROM JULY 25 - BOURSE.

text.p: The stock exchange on Thursday set the rules for the auction of one million shares in leading bank Unibanka at a price of 3.05 lats under which offers can be received from July 25.
The auction will take place on July 28.
The bourse said in a statement it would work out the price of the shares at the auction to one santime and that offers entered above the auction price would be filled in full.
The bourse said the allocation of shares at the auction price would be worked out on a proportional basis.
The settlement date for the auction is July 31.
